name: Wheel Slip Detection
explanation: Wheel tachometer indicates rapid rotation while optical ground speed sensor registers zero motion.

name: Floor Traction Loss / Oil Slick
explanation: Wheel is slipping without chassis incline, indicating low-friction liquid/debris on warehouse floor.

name: Motor Thermal Overload
explanation: Drive motor current draw exceeds 15A and stator thermocouple reads above 85 deg C.

name: Drive Wheel Gearbox Jam
explanation: High motor current with zero rotational speed signifies a stalled gearbox or seized mechanical axle.

name: Encoder Sensor Fault
explanation: Drive commands are being sent by controller but wheel quadrature encoder produces no pulse train.

name: Battery Cell Degradation
explanation: Terminal voltage drops steeply under normal nominal current draw, indicating high internal cell impedance.

name: Battery BMS Thermal Cutoff
explanation: Battery Management System has isolated the pack due to thermal safety limit exceeded (>50 deg C).

name: Gripper Actuator Stall
explanation: Gripper servo draws maximum stall current while jaw displacement sensor indicates jaws failed to close.

name: Lidar Sensor Optical Smudge / Blindness
explanation: LiDAR pointcloud density dropped below threshold in a high airborne particulate environment.

name: Lidar vs Ultrasonic Sensor Discrepancy
explanation: LiDAR detects an obstacle within 0.5m but ultrasonic transducer detects clear path, indicating calibration skew.

name: Vision Camera Lens Smudge
explanation: Crack detector fires indiscriminately across every scanned box under nominal warehouse lighting.

name: Weight Cell Zero-Drift Calibration
explanation: Strain gauge load cell outputs positive weight reading when tray is mechanically verified empty.

name: Docking Contact Oxidation
explanation: High contact resistance across docking pins prevents current transfer despite physical docking alignment.

name: Pallet Elevation Tilt Warning
explanation: Chassis tilt exceeds safe stability envelope (>12 degrees) on a stationary pallet.

name: Drive Train Acoustic Resonance
explanation: Ultrasonic microphone and piezo accelerometer detect classic harmonic signature of bearing raceway spalling.

name: Compound Critical Safety Fault
explanation: Concurrently jammed drive train and overheating windings pose an imminent electrical fire risk.

name: Emergency Hardware E-Stop Active
explanation: Hardware safety relay loop is de-energized, halting all 48V power bus outputs.

name: Technician Action Dispatcher
explanation: Critical fault requires manual Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) inspection prior to restoring automated run status.

name: motor_temp_high, current_draw_excessive
explanation: High motor temperature paired with excessive current draw indicates imminent thermal failure.

name: Motor Overheat Warning
explanation: High motor temperature paired with excessive current draw indicates imminent thermal failure.
